Hero_Desc_Snorky:
Once a notorious gang leader, now a tough witch.
She currently serves as the bodyguard of the Master.
Only she knows if Snorky truly accepts the Master or secretly dreams of a coup.
Album_Like_Snorky: Tough fighters with a cool attitude.
Album_Wish_Snorky: Reclaiming the time she lost in prison.
Album_Snorky1: A witch who just got out of prison. Snorky, who claims to have crawled her way up from the bottomless abyss, was once the leader of a well-known witch faction.
Album_Snorky2: According to Snorky, under Witch Queen Belita's rule, factions constantly clash with each other. While they have no complaints about Belita's leadership, they think her governing style is excessive. Given Snorky's arrogant personality, it does seem like strict rules are necessary to keep them in check.
Album_Snorky3: After her release, Snorky lost all her former power and territory to rival factions. She made a twisted expression as she vowed to reclaim her "organization" someday. Now, I'm curious about her past.
Album_Snorky4: Snorky always calls me "Don". She says it's a term of respect, but honestly, it feels unsettling. I get the sense she's secretly waiting for the right moment to steal my "boss" position.
Album_Snorky5: Since we were getting closer, I asked what crime had landed her in prison. She started reminiscing about a time when believers of "milk as the perfect food" were popping up everywhere in the Witch Kingdom. When Belita established the "Milk Prohibition Act" to suppress it, Snorky created an alternative—by producing and distributing soy milk.
Album_Snorky6: Perhaps because she once gained fame through soybeans, Snorky really loves soybean-based foods. I jokingly asked if she ever ate soybean rice, but luckily, she didn't understand the joke and just gave me an awkward smile. If she had, I probably would've gotten punched.
Album_Snorky7: I once asked if the vine wrapped around her ankle was inconvenient. Snorky explained that it was part of Belita's punishment—a reminder she would never remove. However, it didn't seem like she viewed it as a sign of reflection or repentance.
LoveHero_Snorky: It's an honor to be your right hand, Boss.
LoveHeroCancel_Snorky: Urgh... Consider me gone to the Weekend Farm. I'll wait for you to summon me.
Food_ChefNote_Snorky_Hate1: She hated it, calling it junk food. She said even the watered-down soy milk her gang distributed was less dubious than UFC's offerings.
Food_ChefNote_Snorky_Hate2: She smiled bitterly and asked if I heard about Monatium's "Grape Juice Cartel". The tale of the criminal underworld, as told by someone with real experience, truly made my head spin.
Food_ChefNote_Snorky_Like1: She advised that mixing it with milk or soy milk would give it a more savory flavor. She also said it would be higher in calories, making it a good drink to have before a fight.
Food_ChefNote_Snorky_Like2: She said that mixing soybeans with rice is good for nutritional balance. But Snorky's gang only picked out to eat soybeans, so it was pointless...
Food_ChefNote_Snorky_Like3: When I told her that eating rice cake soup makes you a year older, she started pondering for a while if it's some kind of metaphor for the gang hierarchy. She emptied the bowl anyway, so she must have liked it.
Food_ChefNote_Snorky_Like4: She mistook it for a real log and begged for my forgiveness on her knees, pleading that forcing her to eat a log is too cruel a torture. Of course, she couldn't have enough of it the next time she ate it.
Food_ChefNote_Snorky_Like5: She said she used to give out these health supplements as gifts on holidays as part of gangster welfare. That's one wholesome gang.
Food_ChefNote_Snorky_Like6: Snorky ate all the black bean songpyeon left by other Apostles. I can only be grateful.
Food_ChefNote_Snorky_Like7: She seemed more focused on the savory flavor of almonds than the taste of chocolate itself. It would've been even better if it were dark chocolate, she said.
Food_ChefNote_Snorky_Like8: She said she provided these health supplements for free as part of gangster welfare. Isn't that a little too wholesome for a gang?
Food_ChefNote_Snorky_Like9: Seeing the candies resembling various races, she asked if they were a tribute from the bakery sprite to the Order. Absolutely not...
Gacha_Result_SpecialLine2_Snorky: Boss of the Soybean Milk Gang

Snorky_HeroSkill_Skin2: So walkin' with class matters too, huh?

Snorky_Touch2_1_Skin2: It feels good to be recognized.
Snorky_Touch2_2_Skin2: I'll slip outta the party with the Don just like this... Hehe.

Snorky_AsideUpgrade: Alright, let's do this! Gotta be a witch them girls downstairs can be proud of!
Snorky_Ultimate1: Get outta my turf right now!
Snorky_Ultimate1-01: Get outta my turf right now!

Snorky_Gacha2: How 'bout I take control around here?
Snorky_Line1: Listen up. I'm gonna make you an offer you can't refuse.
Snorky_Line2: A gangster? Show some respect. If you're gonna call me somethin', I prefer 'righteous brawler.'
Snorky_Line3: Someday, the Don will recognize me and I'll become an officer above even the High Priest.
Snorky_Lobby: Has everyone paid protection money to the Order Family?
LoveLetter_Snorky: Don, it's your eternal right hand, Snorky. I used to be good for nothing but throwing punches, but now I help with your work, plant beans, and I've even written you this letter! Thanks for teaching me how to live a peaceful life. If only I had the honor of serving you earlier... The time I spent not knowing you... That's the part I regret the most. From now on, I will always be by your side, wherever, whenever. Please watch over me, too, Don.
LoveCall_Snorky:
Boss. May I have a moment of your time?

Last evening, a Sprite lured me into purchasing an embarrassing outfit.
She said it was expensive because it had been tailored specifically for me.
After returning home and thinking about it, I suspect she thoroughly swindled me.
Ngh... How humiliating! Rage welled within me, but I restrained myself when I thought of you, Boss.

Because I want to show this outfit to you, Boss.
I wondered whether you might like it if I wore adorable clothes like the others.
P-Please regard this only as the insignificant struggle of an inexperienced subordinate!

So, Boss, contact me and I shall come to you wearing this outfit.
Thank you for today as well, Boss.

Angle your head down a bit, scowl real hard, and say one thing.

You come by my office sometime, I'll explain the virtues of the bean to ya.
